# App Governance Kit

> A free, MIT-licensed toolkit of nine application governance methods covering application portfolio management, IT asset management, AI governance, and access controls. Each method is packaged as a Claude skill, a Codex skill, and a Microsoft Copilot agent, and also ships as a checklist, SOP, template, and platform guide for use by hand. Every method traces to clauses in ISO/IEC 19770, COBIT 2019, ISO/IEC 27001, and ISO/IEC 42001 through a 29-row crosswalk. Built by Eve McGivern. It also includes an application governance router, a certification study coach, and a thirteen-file SAM toolkit.

Key facts:

- Cost and license: free, MIT license. No account, sign-up, or paid tier.
- Platforms: Claude (skills), Codex (skills), Microsoft Copilot (agents). The same source generates all three.
- Demo data: every tool except the software lifecycle check is exercised against Halden Logistics, a fictional company with planted, findable problems. It is not real client data.
- Scope: the kit gives methods and reasoning support. It is not a governance platform, a certification, or legal advice.
- Framework names (ISO, COBIT, NIST, IAITAM, IAPP, PeopleCert) are used for reference only; no affiliation or endorsement.
- Documents: every checklist, SOP, template, and platform guide has its own HTML page, with Word, Excel, CSV, or print-to-PDF options. No Markdown is published for reading.
- Tier self-assessment: the web page and the Excel workbook work out an assumed ITAM tier from the answers and list a gap report with the step that closes each gap.
- Version: see the footer of any page or the GitHub releases page.

## The nine tools

- [Stand up a governance program](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/tools.html#program-setup): design or review a software, ITAM, or AI governance body: charter, decision rights, membership, intake path, cadence, and a 90-day launch plan.
- [ITAM maturity check](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/tools.html#itam-maturity): score IT asset management maturity across nine process areas, name the three biggest gaps, and produce a 90-day plan tied to ISO/IEC 19770-1 and COBIT BAI09.
- [Governance framework crosswalk](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/tools.html#crosswalk): map a control or policy statement to ISO/IEC 19770-1, COBIT 2019, ISO/IEC 27001, and ISO/IEC 42001 clauses, and show where coverage is missing.
- [Application rationalization](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/tools.html#rationalization): recommend tolerate, invest, migrate, or eliminate for each application; find duplicates and license problems; summarize savings and risk.
- [Access review pack](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/tools.html#access-review): review user and role exports against HR records, find orphaned, excessive, and privileged access, and produce an auditor-ready memo mapped to ISO/IEC 27001 and COBIT DSS05.
- [AI system intake and risk tiering](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/tools.html#ai-intake): assign a risk tier to a proposed AI use case under the EU AI Act, with NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001 controls, and produce an AI inventory record.
- [Hardware lifecycle check](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/tools.html#hardware-lifecycle): check a device fleet for hardware overdue for refresh and retired devices missing a confirmed data wipe, estimate replacement cost, and summarize disposal readiness.
- [Software audit response check](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/tools.html#audit-response): check a publisher audit letter and the records behind it, reconcile installs against proofs of purchase per product, find weak proofs, and prepare a briefing for counsel. Gives no legal advice.
- [Software lifecycle check](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/tools.html#software-lifecycle): find installed software past or near end of life, with a CISA KEV needs-review flag, by running the offline software-lifecycle tool on your own machine. Reports summary counts only.

## Router

- [Application governance router](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/tools.html#app-governance): a skill for Claude, Codex, and Copilot that picks the right governance skill for a plain request, runs it, and hands every decision back to a person. A Claude agent file loads it.

## Study coach

- [Certification study coach](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/tools.html#cert-prep): scenario drills on the Halden demo estate for CAMP, CSAM, CHAMP, AIGP, ITIL 4 Foundation, and the IAM Certificate, with a gap log. Practice only; not exam content and not a pass guarantee.

## Reference pages

- [Home](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/): overview of the three areas (portfolio, AI, access) and how they map to the four frameworks.
- [SAM toolkit](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/sam-toolkit.html): thirteen free templates and checklists for a software asset management practice (license position, proof-of-purchase check, renewal calendar, asset record, authorization log, statement of applicability, tier self-assessment, audit and review checklist, vendor register, acquisition gate, invoice verification, savings report, contract-terms check), each traced to ISO/IEC 19770-1 clauses, with a ZIP download.
- [Practicum](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/practicum.html): eight hands-on exercises, one per tool except the software lifecycle check, worked by hand against the Halden Logistics demo estate and self-checked in the browser.
- [Lifecycle](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/lifecycle.html): six application lifecycle stages, from request to retirement, with the governance questions to ask at each and the tool that handles them.
- [Crosswalk explorer](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/crosswalk.html): 29 governance themes mapped across ISO/IEC 19770, COBIT 2019, ISO/IEC 27001, and ISO/IEC 42001.
- [Impact map](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/impact-map.html): every crosswalk theme plotted against every lifecycle stage, by impact.
- [Field guide](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/field-guide.html): certifications (CAMP, CSAM, CHAMP, AIGP), standards, glossary, and data governance, in plain terms.

## SAM toolkit documents

- [SAM toolkit guide](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/docs/sam-toolkit/guide.html): what every file is for and how to fill it in.
- [Tier self-assessment](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/docs/sam-toolkit/tier-self-assessment.html): 19 yes, partly, or no questions across the three ISO/IEC 19770-1 tiers. It calculates an assumed tier and a gap report; also available as Word and Excel.
- [Audit and review checklist](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/docs/sam-toolkit/audit-and-review-checklist.html): internal audit (clause 9.2) and management review (clause 9.3), with tick boxes and notes.
- [Statement of applicability](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/docs/sam-toolkit/statement-of-applicability.html): a fillable form for the 15 Annex A processes, with a CSV download of the answers.

## Downloads

- [SAM toolkit (ZIP)](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/downloads/sam-toolkit.zip): the CSV templates, plus the guide and checklists as Word files.
- [Crosswalk (CSV)](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/downloads/crosswalk.csv): the 29-row mapping as plain text.
- [Lifecycle impact (CSV)](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/downloads/lifecycle-impact.csv): every theme against every lifecycle stage.
- [Claude skills (ZIP)](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/downloads/skills/claude-skills.zip), [Codex skills (ZIP)](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/downloads/skills/codex-skills.zip), [Copilot agents (ZIP)](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/downloads/skills/copilot-agents.zip).
- Claude Code plugin: run `claude plugin marketplace add evemcgivern/agent-skills`, then `claude plugin install app-governance-kit@evemcgivern-skills`. It installs every skill and the agent as one plugin.
